league.description: Key of the com.professorbutts.sports.league record, lowercase, e.g. 'nfl'.

people.description: com.professorbutts.sports.person records featured, e.g. a race winner.

subject.description: The com.professorbutts.sports.game or com.professorbutts.sports.leaderboard record the recap covers.

document.description: The site.standard.document record that holds the recap. A uri, not a strongRef, because the document can be corrected in place.

subjectCid.description: Version of the subject record the recap was written from. Game records are updated in place.

documentCid.description: Optional: the document version this was written for.

main.description: Record key is the subject record's key, e.g. 'nfl-401772936', so a game's recap is one getRecord away.

description: Links a recap article (a site.standard.document record) to the game, race or tournament it covers, so indexers can join recaps to the sports graph without reading the article. Same pattern as a domain sidecar next to a standard.site document. The game or leaderboard record's own recap field points the other way.
